task.description:
Write test specifications and unit tests for API-06 shared pagination module.

API-06 standardizes cursor-based pagination across all list endpoints. The new src/api/pagination.zig module provides:
- Cursor encode/decode (base64url, prefix validation, 24h expiry)
- PageResponse(T) generic response envelope
- validatePageSize (1-200, default 50)

Test specifications (write to tests/specs/API-06.md):
- TC-API-06-01: validatePageSize(null) returns 50 (default)
- TC-API-06-02: validatePageSize(0) → error
- TC-API-06-03: validatePageSize(1) → 1
- TC-API-06-04: validatePageSize(200) → 200
- TC-API-06-05: validatePageSize(201) → error
- TC-API-06-06: encodeCursor / decodeCursor round-trip with valid prefix
- TC-API-06-07: decodeCursor with invalid base64url → error
- TC-API-06-08: decodeCursor with wrong prefix → cross-endpoint rejection
- TC-API-06-09: decodeCursor with expired timestamp (>24h) → 410
- TC-API-06-10: decodeCursor with malformed segments → error
- TC-API-06-11: all list endpoints return cursor when more pages exist
- TC-API-06-12: last page returns null cursor
- TC-API-06-13: cursor from one endpoint rejected on another (T: prefix on I: endpoint)

Implementation (write to tests/unit/test_api06_pagination.zig):
- Unit tests for validatePageSize (all boundary conditions)
- Unit tests for Cursor encode/decode round-trip
- Unit tests for cursor prefix validation (cross-endpoint rejection)
- Unit tests for cursor expiry (24h threshold)
- Unit tests for buildRawCursor and buildRawCursorTimestampKey helpers
- Verify existing endpoint tests still pass (cursor format changes may need updates)

Acceptance criteria:
- tests/specs/API-06.md exists
- tests/unit/test_api06_pagination.zig exists
- zig build test exits 0
- All new tests pass
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/API-06.md exists with complete test case specifications
Coverage for page size validation, cursor encode/decode, prefix rejection, expiry

result.summary: Test specifications and unit tests for API-06 shared pagination module. Created tests/specs/API-06.md with 20 test case specifications covering page size validation, cursor encode/decode round-trips, prefix rejection, expiry, malformed inputs, and all helper functions. Created tests/unit/test_api06_pagination.zig with 36 unit tests. Added pagination to api_mod.zig exports and registered the test artifact in build.zig. All tests pass; zig build test exits 0.
